verdict.rationale: OneDrive/SharePoint docs confirm shared folders, external sharing, and creating shareable links (createLink) plus version history, which support a basic data-room-like setup [onedrive-docs-9][onedrive-docs-13][onedrive-docs-8]. However, the evidence pack never documents view-only link types, download-blocking controls, or an access-visibility/audit view for tracking who has viewed files — the specific diligence-room features the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit view-only/no-download link settings, download prevention controls, and access/activity visibility reporting for shared folders.
